overview.description: The Aristotle Core Plus Income ETF (ARCP) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests primarily in investment-grade income-producing debt instruments. The fund seeks a high level of current income, with capital growth as a secondary objective. ARCP was launched on Jul 29, 2026 and is issued by Aristotle.
